summary: POSCO HOLDINGS INC. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of its 1Q 2026 quarterly report, prepared under K-IFRS and submitted to the Korean Financial Services Commission. This is a routine periodic disclosure containing segment financials—Steel, Infrastructure, Rechargeable Battery Materials—and no transaction, corporate action, or special situation is announced. The filing is strictly a periodic report with no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are present. It is a standard foreign private issuer filing and not a special situation.
